summary: Osisko Gold Group Inc. filed a Form 6-K to report a name change from Osisko Development Corp., effective July 14, 2026, following shareholder approval on June 23, 2026. The common shares will trade under new ticker 'OGG' on TSXV and NYSE starting July 20, 2026, with corresponding warrant ticker changes and new CUSIP/ISINs. No financial terms, premium, or transaction structure were disclosed. This is a routine corporate action, not a special situation, as there is no acquisition, divestiture, or other event-driven catalyst identified.
